messages:
sanjay: Customer reported monthly credits hit 0 several hours before their local midnight. They saw 429s then a refill ~45m late. Asked if this is DST/proration or bug.
elaine: Can you paste org_id and the tenant's timezone? Also any sample request_ids from the 429 responses?
sanjay: org: org_0x9a, tz: America/Los_Angeles. sample header from customer: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: req_abc123
x-credits-remaining: 0
x-next-refill: 2024-05-01T07:00:00Z
```
They expected refill at 2024-05-01T08:00:00-07:00 => 2024-05-02T03:00:00Z? (customer confused).
quota-bot: Automated note: Billing event processed for org_0x9a at 2024-05-01T07:15:12Z, credits added: 100000 tokens.
mike: Quick hypothesis: edge cache (TTL 60s) + clock skew between billing service and edge cache invalidation could cause customers to see 0 for a bit. Any evidence of cache invalidation failures?
tara: Billing ledger shows pro-rata adjustment on plan change two days ago; that triggered a delayed archival job touching the same tenant. The job completed at 2024-05-01T07:14:55Z.
eng-oncall: Can we share the proxy logs around req_abc123? I want to see upstream validation and whether refill event hit the token service before the edge check.
sanjay: Pasted proxy snippet from customer timeframe: 
```
[2024-05-01T07:13:48Z] req=req_abc123 check_quota tenant=org_0x9a result=NO_TOKEN cache_hit=true
[2024-05-01T07:14:56Z] billing_event processed tenant=org_0x9a credits=100000
[2024-05-01T07:15:10Z] req=req_def456 check_quota tenant=org_0x9a result=OK cache_hit=false
```
elaine: That looks like the billing event finished slightly before the next request, but the first request still saw cache_hit=true (stale). So invalidate path didn't fire or the cache entry had a longer local TTL.
mike: Yep. I dug into cache configs — edge had backoff TTL of 300s in some regions during the rollout two weeks ago. That would explain ~45m latency in visibility in worst cases. Rolling back patch now.
eng-oncall: Rolling back patch to edge-cache TTL to restore normal 60s behavior in us-west. Patch id: edge-cache-rollback-20240501. I expect propagation ~5-10m.
tara: Customer-facing explanation ready: "We processed your refill on X time, but a regional cache returned stale quota state for a short window. We've fixed the cache config and you should not see delayed refills going forward. Sorry for the confusion." :handshake:
sanjay: Sent note to customer with timeline and apology. Will monitor for any other tenants impacted.
elaine: Thx. Filing postmortem note for billing->cache invalidation race + rollout change. Assign to eng-infra + billing.
mike: Follow-up action: add test that simulates concurrent billing event + cache read to catch this.
sanjay: Customer replied "thanks, all good" and confirmed their UI updated after ~7 minutes. Closing on our side. :white_check_mark:
